Definition: to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate
BiblicalUsage: Kaphash means to tread down — to humiliate, to grind into the dust. Jeremiah says, He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, He hath covered me with ashes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the verse is the bottom of the lament: teeth broken on gravel, a man trodden into ashes — and even there, the prophet goes on to say that His compassions fail not.
